At CFS, we remain committed to sustainability and the cooperative way of doing business, where members own the company, guide the decision-making process, and share the benefits that come from working together.
Formed by the union of strong, successful ag-focused cooperatives with rich traditions and deep roots in the communities we serve, We are shaped by our past experience, not bound by it. We use what we have learned as a foundation that allows us to work efficiently in the present, and we are focused on shaping the future. In all we do, we are guided by five core principles.
WE CONSIDER OUR CUSTOMERS FIRST.
WE HARNESS CHANGE FOR THE BENEFIT OF OUR MEMBER/OWNERS.
WE GIVE BACK TO OUR COMMUNITIES.
WE PROVIDE AVENUES FOR EMPLOYEE GROWTH AND SUCCESS.
WE ALL OWN THIS.
CFS PRODUCTS AND SERVICES
AGRONOMY
Today’s agriculture is equal parts experience, equipment, technology, and insight. The CFS agronomy department has all four covered.
Agronomy >
GRAIN
In this digital age, speed is everything. Bigger equipment means a shorter harvest, so our facilities are geared to handle your grain quickly, get you back to the field, and keep that grain in top condition until it’s marketed.
Grain >
FEED
Quality feed at competitive prices—with the experience and product knowledge to back up the sale. That’s what you want in a feed supplier, and that’s what we offer at CFS.
Feed >
ENERGY
We’ve worked hard to build a reputation for responsive energy service. Whatever your energy need, we can meet it.
Energy >
STAY CONNECTED ON THE FARM, IN THE CAB, OR IN THE OFFICE.
It’s all in the palm of your hands! All you need to do is grab your phone and open the CFS app and it connects you with your account, agronomist, and data. It is simple to use and is a great way to stay connected with all the information that is pertinent to your operation.

Central Farm Service (CFS) Appoints KC Graner as New CEO, Effective January 1, 2025
Truman, MN – July 16, 2024 – Central Farm Service (CFS) is pleased to announce the appointment of KC Graner as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective January 1, 2025. KC, who currently serves as the Senior Vice President of Agronomy, will transition into his new role with nearly seven years of exceptional service in his current position. He will succeed Merlyn Kruger, the current CEO, who announced his retirement plans earlier this year.
During his tenure as Senior Vice President of Agronomy, KC has been instrumental in driving significant growth for CFS. Under his leadership, CFS Agronomy revenues have grown from $104 million in sales in 2018 to $173 million in sales in 2023. His unwavering commitment to extreme customer focus and dedication to servicing the owners of CFS has been a cornerstone of this success.
KC's extensive knowledge of the cooperative system and his forward-thinking approach have been evident in his initiatives, such as leading CFS’s digital engagement efforts through the CFS App, enhancing customer interaction and service delivery.
